results.label: Toy BPE learns merges from eleven words

request.summary: Count adjacent symbol pairs across eleven fictional classroom words (54 word occurrences), merge the most frequent pair, and repeat 18 times. No model API request is used.

results.output:
Learned 18 merges. Most frequent first merge: "b + o" (17 occurrences).
robots -> robot | s</w>
learners (unseen) -> learn | e | r | s</w>
playful (unseen) -> play | f | u | l | </w>
zebra (unseen) -> z | e | b | r | a | </w>

display.text: Byte-pair encoding starts from single characters (plus an end-of-word marker) and repeatedly merges the most frequent adjacent pair. Frequent chunks become single tokens.

display.title: Segmenting words with the learned merges

results.label: The same sentence in eight languages (GPT-4o)

request.summary: Send each sentence as one user message to GPT-4o with max_tokens 1. The reported prompt tokens minus a calibrated 7-token chat overhead (measured with the one-token message "a") is the sentence's token count.

results.output:
English: 9 tokens for 38 characters (1x English)
Polish: 11 tokens for 29 characters (1.22x English)
German: 11 tokens for 45 characters (1.22x English)
Spanish: 12 tokens for 37 characters (1.33x English)
Russian: 14 tokens for 33 characters (1.56x English)
Japanese: 12 tokens for 14 characters (1.33x English)
Arabic: 14 tokens for 36 characters (1.56x English)
Hindi: 13 tokens for 30 characters (1.44x English)

results.label: Numbers, code, emoji, and whitespace (GPT-4o)

request.summary: Measure token counts for dates, long digit strings, number words, code, emoji, repeated letters, URLs, and runs of spaces with the same calibrated method.

results.output:
Date: 6 tokens for 10 characters (1.67 characters/token)
Sixteen digits: 6 tokens for 16 characters (2.67 characters/token)
Number in words: 7 tokens for 44 characters (6.29 characters/token)
Code: 20 tokens for 43 characters (2.15 characters/token)
Five emoji: 5 tokens for 5 characters (1 characters/token)
Twenty letter a: 3 tokens for 20 characters (6.67 characters/token)
URL: 14 tokens for 31 characters (2.21 characters/token)
Ten spaces: 3 tokens for 12 characters (4 characters/token)

results.label: Does another model count the same? (GPT-5-mini)

request.summary: Repeat the eight-language measurement with the GPT-5-mini deployment (max_completion_tokens 16, minimal reasoning). Its calibrated chat overhead is 6 tokens.

results.output:
8 of 8 sentence counts equal GPT-4o.
English: GPT-4o 9, GPT-5-mini 9
Polish: GPT-4o 11, GPT-5-mini 11
German: GPT-4o 11, GPT-5-mini 11
Spanish: GPT-4o 12, GPT-5-mini 12
Russian: GPT-4o 14, GPT-5-mini 14
Japanese: GPT-4o 12, GPT-5-mini 12
Arabic: GPT-4o 14, GPT-5-mini 14
Hindi: GPT-4o 13, GPT-5-mini 13

display.text: GPT-5-mini calibrated overhead: 6 tokens (GPT-4o: 7). Do not assume tokenizers are identical across models; measure them.
